annotation.bound_parties_text: The strategy sets out Federal Government measures and binds no private parties; it describes what the Federal Government will do.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: the Federal Government is focusing its measures with regard to current developments in the field of artificial intelligence (AI)
annotation.dates_quote: December 2020: With its updated AI Strategy, the Federal Government responds to new developments in the field of AI
annotation.robot_provision_quote: With the update of the Artificial Intelligence Strategy, the Federal Government is focusing its measures with regard to current developments in the field of artificial intelligence (AI)
